metadata.name: generic-dtc-catalog
metadata.description: Hand-curated subset of generic (SAE/ISO defined, second character '0') diagnostic trouble code descriptions.
metadata.source: Public generic OBD-II documentation (SAE J2012 code definitions). Cross-checked by the project team by eye; not machine verified.
metadata.review_note: This is a starting point, not an authority. Manufacturer specific codes (second character '1') and the Iranian market vehicle families have NOT been researched yet; those entries must be added only with documented evidence (service literature, logs, verified captures). Descriptions are informational and must not be used to decide about repairs on their own.

codes.P0100: Mass or volume air flow circuit malfunction
codes.P0101: Mass or volume air flow circuit range/performance problem
codes.P0102: Mass or volume air flow circuit low input
codes.P0103: Mass or volume air flow circuit high input
codes.P0113: Intake air temperature circuit high input
codes.P0117: Engine coolant temperature circuit low input
codes.P0118: Engine coolant temperature circuit high input
codes.P0120: Throttle position sensor/switch A circuit malfunction
codes.P0121: Throttle position sensor/switch A circuit range/performance problem
codes.P0122: Throttle position sensor/switch A circuit low input
codes.P0133: O2 sensor circuit slow response (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0135: O2 sensor heater circuit malfunction (bank 1, sensor 1)
codes.P0335: Crankshaft position sensor A circuit malfunction
codes.P0340: Camshaft position sensor A circuit malfunction (bank 1)
codes.P0442: Evaporative emission system leak detected (small leak)
codes.P0455: Evaporative emission system leak detected (gross leak/no flow)
codes.P0601: Internal control module memory checksum error
codes.P0700: Transmission control system malfunction (malfunction indicator lamp request)
codes.U0100: Lost communication with engine control module/powertrain control module A
codes.U0121: Lost communication with anti-lock brake system control module
